name: known-p-uniform-population

model.latent: A_l independent Bernoulli(p); joint independence is a declared model hypothesis
model.observation: Conditional on A, independent population draws have correctness probability q=(1-c)*p+c*sum(w_l*A_l); R_j=E[q^j+(1-q)^j]. No truth is needed to count agreement; p is externally declared/calibrated, not inferred from agreement.
model.target: unique(c,K), hence K_eff=K only within this declared uniform family
model.samplingBoundary: Population moments/with-replacement conditional draws. Finite distinct-member observations need their finite population correction; observed moments also need dependent-pair uncertainty. No finite-sample inverse guarantee here.

classification: exact population vector; not a sample estimate
